annotations.title: Read Local OKF Note with Backlinks

description: Read the complete Markdown content, parsed YAML frontmatter, outgoing [[wiki-links]], incoming backlinks, and extracted action items for a single known note. Use this after discovering a note via okf_search_meetings, okf_list_action_items, or okf_topic_graph; do not use it for fuzzy keyword search across multiple files. Read-only and 100% offline. Returns a structured JSON note object, or sets isError: true with a "Note not found" message if no file path, slug, or title matches target.

target.description: Exact relative file path (e.g. "2026-11-15-architecture-sync.md"), filename slug (e.g. "local-ai-pipeline"), note title, or [[wiki-link]] reference (e.g. "[[Local AI Pipeline]]").

name: okf_read_note
